payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort remaining power-of-two values descending; greedily add or subtract each to drive target T toward zero; check if T becomes exactly zero.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts the middle characters' values (powers of two) and uses a greedy algorithm: for each largest remaining value, it adds if T<0 else subtracts, which optimally reduces absolute T due to the powers' growth. The last two characters have fixed signs, handled before sorting.
